description: Use this when the user wants to see real portfolios to learn from or copy (e.g. "show me low-drawdown dividend portfolios", "portfolios that hold SCHD", "the best risk-adjusted portfolios on Redstone"): the public portfolios Redstone's users built and shared, and Redstone's model portfolios, with past-year returns, risk and yield. Describe the kind of portfolio with the figure filters where one fits; nameIncludes only matches names, so keep it for themes no figure captures, such as "AI". Up to 10 results. Not for the user's own brokerage account or for recommending a portfolio to buy.

items.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, VOO or BRK.B

madeBy.description: community: portfolios users built and shared; redstone: Redstone's model portfolios

maxDrawdownNoWorseThanPct.description: Keep portfolios whose worst fall over the past year was no deeper than this, e.g. -10

nameIncludes.description: Words to look for in portfolio names, e.g. 'dividend' or 'AI'; any one matching is enough

order.description: desc puts the highest first; for drawdown the highest is the shallowest

name: search_portfolios

asOf.description: Market date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the latest close behind every number

beta1y.description: Versus SPY, from daily returns over the past year

dividendYieldPct.description: Trailing 12-month dividend yield: dividends that went ex in the past year over the latest close. 0 pays none; null when unknown (paid in another currency)

madeBy.description: community: built and shared by a Redstone user; redstone: one of Redstone's model portfolios

maxDrawdown1yPct.description: Worst peak-to-trough fall over the past year (negative)

statsSince.description: YYYY-MM-DD, set only when there is less than a year of history: the 1Y figures (return, drawdown, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, beta, alpha, yield) then run from this first close, and so does the YTD return if it falls this year. Screens on those metrics leave such securities out

volatility1yPct.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns over the past year

url.description: Redstone's portfolio library, to sort and filter

title: Find shared and model portfolios
